BoolProperty.Name: CreateIndex
BoolProperty.Description: Create an archive index (cf. ranlib). This can speed up linking and reduce dependency within its own library.

BoolProperty.Name: CreateThinArchive
BoolProperty.Description: Create a thin archive. A thin archive contains relativepaths to the objects instead of embedding the objects. Switching between Thin and Normal requires deleting the existing library.

BoolProperty.Name: NoWarnOnCreate
BoolProperty.Description: Do not warn if when the library is created.

BoolProperty.Name: TruncateTimestamp
BoolProperty.Description: Use zero for timestamps and uids/gids.

StringProperty.Name: OutputFile
StringProperty.Description: Override the default name and location of the library.
